title: Semi-NMF dictionary of activations
description: Factor activations into nonnegative codes times an unconstrained dictionary with semi-nonnegative matrix factorization, solved by alternating nonnegative proximal-gradient and least-squares updates with unit-norm atoms, instead of training an SAE. Features in these models fire with nonnegative magnitude, which matches the nonnegative-code assumption, and there is no amortized encoder to cause absorption. Prediction: recovers the planted feature directions at least as well as a tuned TopK SAE.

source.title: Decomposing MLP Activations into Interpretable Features via Semi-Nonnegative Matrix Factorization
